title: znote detection rules
description: What znote hides besides the glossary: patterns such as e-mail addresses and amounts, and how the name finder's kinds map to hiding levels. Language-specific words live in languages/.

ignorable.description: Unicode code points (hex, or a range "200B-200F") that are invisible and skipped when matching, such as zero-width spaces and soft hyphens.

spaces.description: Characters read as a space when matching, such as Typst's non-breaking ~.

number.description: Regular expression for the number in an amount.

labels.description: Pairs of the label the name finder is asked for and the kind of token it becomes.

levels.description: The lowest hiding level at which a kind found by the name finder is hidden.

defaultLevel.description: The level for kinds not listed in levels.

regex.description: Regular expression (Rust regex syntax). {symbols}, {codes}, {number}, {scale} and {trunk} are filled in from the currencies, the number and every language's scale words and phone trunks.

check.description: An extra check a hit must pass.

trim.description: Characters taken off the end of a hit.

amounts.description: Hidden only when hiding amounts is on.
